title: one table, five rules, and the row each one turns away

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE products (
  id    int  PRIMARY KEY,
  sku   text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name  text NOT NULL,
  price numeric(8,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price >= 0),
  gtin  text UNIQUE,
  shelf text UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT
);
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'TEA-01', 'assam tea', 6.50, NULL, NULL)
steps.note: a products table with a rule on every column that needs one.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (2, 'TEA-02', NULL, 5.00, NULL, 'A1')
steps.note: a product with no name. NOT NULL turns it away: 23502.

error.message: null value in column "name" of relation "products" violates not-null constraint
error.detail: Failing row contains (2, TEA-02, null, 5.00, null, A1).

steps.sql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (2, 'TEA-02', 'green tea', -5.00, NULL, 'A1')
steps.note: a negative price. the CHECK is false for this row: 23514.

error.message: new row for relation "products" violates check constraint "products_price_check"
error.detail: Failing row contains (2, TEA-02, green tea, -5.00, null, A1).

steps.sql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (2, 'TEA-01', 'green tea', 5.00, NULL, 'A1')
steps.note: a sku that's taken. UNIQUE finds it in its index: 23505.

error.message: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "products_sku_key"

steps.sql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (2, 'TEA-02', 'green tea', 5.00, NULL, 'A1')
steps.note: a second product with no gtin. plain UNIQUE treats NULLs as distinct, so two NULLs are fine.

steps.sql: SELECT id, sku, gtin, shelf FROM products ORDER BY id
INSERT INTO products VALUES (3, 'MUG-01', 'blue mug', 9.00, NULL, NULL)
steps.note: shelf is UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT: Assam already has a NULL shelf, so a second NULL is a duplicate.

error.message: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "products_shelf_key"

steps.note: a playlist with positions, unique per playlist. three kinds of UNIQUE, one shift.
plain UNIQUE is checked row by row. moving 1 to 2 collides with the 2 that hasn't moved yet.

error.message: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "plain_pos_key"

steps.note: DEFERRABLE (initially immediate) is checked at the end of the statement, when every row has moved. no collision.

steps.sql: SELECT pos, song FROM later ORDER BY pos

steps.note: INITIALLY DEFERRED waits until COMMIT. in between, a transaction can hold duplicates.
and if they're still duplicates at COMMIT, the COMMIT fails and the whole transaction rolls back.

error.message: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "deferred_pos_key"

steps.sql: SELECT pos, song FROM deferred ORDER BY pos
